_about: Typos printed in the official documents. The text stays exactly as printed; import_ccr.py (apply_sic_markers) adds an EssentialRegs [sic] marker (span.er-sic, tooltip 'Printed this way in the official document.') directly after the printed string in the named provision. `printed` must occur exactly `expect` times (default 1) in that provision's text or the parse reports it for review. Only plain typos belong here, never unusual wording.
